did.unittitle: William Rockefeller family papers

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: A miscellaneous assortment of materials pertaining to William Rockefeller, his wife, his children and their descendants.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The William Rockefeller papers were donated in 1976.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.
